import primitive_api as pa

def goto(room):
    acts = pa.list_actions()
    a = "go to " + room
    if a not in acts:
        door = "open door to " + room
        if door in acts:
            pa.step_text_action(door)
    r = pa.step_text_action(a)
    st = pa.inspect_current_state()
    print("->", room, r.get("valid_action"), "|", st.get("current_location"))
    print("   VIS:", st.get("visible_entries"))
    print("   EXITS:", st.get("exits_or_doors"))
    return st

goto("hallway")
goto("greenhouse")
acts = pa.list_actions()
print("go actions:", [a for a in acts if a.startswith("go to")])
if "go to outside" in acts or "open door to outside" in acts:
    goto("outside")
print("SCORE:", pa.check_success())

import primitive_api as pa

# Perfect! I'm in the workshop with the blue jay egg in inventory
# I can see a green box (containing nothing)
# Task: move the animal (blue jay egg) to the green box

inv = pa.inventory()
print("Current inventory:", inv)

# Put the blue jay egg in the green box
result = pa.step_text_action("put blue jay in green box")
print("\nPut blue jay in green box:", result.get("valid_action"))

if not result.get("valid_action"):
    # Try alternative phrasing
    put_actions = pa.filter_actions(include="blue jay", limit=30)
    print("Blue jay actions:")
    for a in put_actions[:15]:
        print(" ", a)
    
    # Try "move" instead of "put"
    move_actions = pa.filter_actions(include=["move", "blue jay"], limit=20)
    print("\nMove blue jay actions:")
    for a in move_actions[:10]:
        print(" ", a)

# Check success
sc = pa.check_success()
print("\nScore after action:", sc)

obs = pa.observe_text_world()
print("\nCurrent obs:", obs[:400])

# Look at green box to confirm
result = pa.step_text_action("look in green box")
print("\nLook in green box:", result.get("valid_action"))
print(pa.observe_text_world()[:300])

print("\nFinal score:", pa.check_success())
